questions.q: Explain what 9:58-60 teaches about zakah. (4 marks, our own question)
questions.a: Zakah goes only to the eight groups named (9:60), as a duty from Allah; it is not to be given by personal favour (9:58-59).
questions.model: Point 1: zakah has set recipients. Develop: 9:60 lists the poor, the needy and six other groups. Point 2: it is an obligation from Allah. Develop: 'an obligation from Allah' (9:60), so Muslims distribute it as Allah commands, not by favour.
